objective.name: test.slow
objective.description: Test tool: waits until its gate is opened, then answers.

#root.role: Wait until the named gate is open in the gates matter, then answer.

transformation_contract.morphing: A gate name and a value become the same value once the gate is open.
invariants: The call never answers before the gate is open.
The gate state is read from the gates matter, never kept in memory, so a wrapper restart does not lose it.
success: The response carries the gate, the value and the call rank once the gate is open.
notes: Executed by the test_tools Python wrapper. Test infrastructure only: it carries no business logic and exists to exercise the agentic mechanics.

effects.tool_calls: Appends one entry when the call starts and one when it is released.
